    'meas_level': 1,
    'meas_return': 'avg',
    'shots': 512
}

num_spec01_freqs = 71
GHz = 1.0e9  # Gigahertz

    return [AcquireChannel(i) for i in range(gv['backend_config'].n_qubits)]

    center_freq = round(center_freqs[qubit], -8)  # 2 significant digits
